reviews.notes: Claude final review: H3.1 4K clock tower + transit hall, scale-only run (22 m, base Z=0, centred, no topology edits). Silhouette, palette, clock face, arched entrance, banners and planters match the reference. Known: raised lid on the hall roof (Sol rounds 1-2; Astra's roof repair db6aee did not improve it, so the unmodified geometry is kept); glass not separable; softened edges. Roof top barely visible from plaza eye level. Exterior shell only.
